svg.title: Vitalii Borovyk's GitHub contributions as a landscape: 8,645 contributions · Oct 2025 – Oct 2026
svg.desc: One plateau per week, 53 plateaus from left to right. Plateau height is the square root of its total, capped at 888 contributions (the 99th percentile of the totals); empty weeks stay on the ground. A walker crosses the year in a 61-second loop, climbing ladders and ropes, sliding down the steep drops, sawing trees and pushing boulders on the busiest weeks, and plants a flag by the campfire on the busiest one: 888 contributions · Sep 27 – Oct 3, 2026.
